systems.system: iPayMoney university enrolment and fee-payment platform
systems.owner: i-Futur, a Nigerien fintech, for the public universities; UNCDF, EU and OACPS grant
systems.tiers: higher education only: online registration and fee payment at the University of Maradi (more than 7,700 students enrolled online in 2023), being adopted in Niamey and Agadez

note: University enrolment and payment only; higher education is outside the study and no primary or secondary school system is named.
